payload.rebuttal: argued: The probe only swaps the order of two adjacent, independent lines in the Commands block (the `saffron review` line and the `saffron package` line trade places); the text of the `saffron package` line itself is untouched and still reads '...run PACKAGE alone on a task whose own PACKAGE raised, or whose cell raised but rebuilds green.' The test finds that line by searching the full file text for the leading substring 'run PACKAGE alone on a task whose own PACKAGE raised,' per the spec's own instruction to anchor on leading text rather than a line number, so it is unaffected by two sibling lines trading places. Reordering two reference-table lines is not a wrong version of 'name the raise, not just the green cell' -- it changes nothing about whether the package line names the raise. The probe surviving shows the probe doesn't express the claim's content, not that the test is blind to a real regression.
